name: CIB seven - Mail Delete
description: Delete e-mails from a folder via the CIB seven mail connector (connectorId: mail-delete). IMAP settings come from MAIL_CONFIG.

properties.label: Folder
properties.description: Mailbox folder to delete from. Clear this field to fall back to 'mail.poll.folder' from MAIL_CONFIG.

properties.label: Message IDs
properties.description: Provide exactly ONE selector (Message IDs, Message numbers, or Mails). Must be an expression resolving to a list of RFC Message-IDs (List<String>), e.g. ${messageIds}. A literal value is rejected by the connector at runtime.

pattern.message: must be an expression resolving to a List<String>, e.g. ${messageIds}

properties.label: Message numbers
properties.description: Alternative selector. Must be an expression resolving to a list of message numbers within the folder (List<Integer>), e.g. ${messageNumbers}. Strings are not converted - the connector casts to Integer.

pattern.message: must be an expression resolving to a List<Integer>, e.g. ${messageNumbers}

properties.label: Mails
properties.description: Alternative selector. Must be an expression resolving to the list of mails to delete (List<Mail>), e.g. ${mails} as returned by a Mail Poll task.

pattern.message: must be an expression resolving to a List<Mail>, e.g. ${mails}
